name: tabs
title: Tabs 标签页
description: 在同一位置切换显示几组相关内容。

whenToUse: 同一层级、互相独立的几块内容
responsive: 标签过多时横向滚动，不要换成多行

files.content:
# Tabs 设计规范

- 用于在同一位置切换同级内容。跨页面用导航链接，有先后顺序的步骤用 Stepper，表单中的单选用 Radio Group。
- 每个 `Tabs.Trigger` 与对应的 `Tabs.Content` 用相同的 `value`；用 `bind:value` 绑定当前标签，需要时同步到网址查询参数。
- 样式只用 `Tabs.List` 的 `variant`（`default`、`line`、`capsule`），不要自己写下划线或背景。
- `capsule` 参考 Linear 项目时间线的 Health／Leads 侧栏，列表高 32 px，圆角 5 px，标签间距 2 px。触发器高 28 px，标签横向留白 12 px，字为 12 px／500。水平列表占满可用宽度，短标签均分空间。手动模式下方向键只移动焦点，由 Space 或 Enter 激活。默认、线型与胶囊的水平触发器均为 28 px 高，列表高 32 px。垂直列表按内容排列。
- 为 `Tabs.List` 设置可访问名称。水平列表宽度受父容器约束，超出时横向滚动并露出键盘焦点。Home／End 到达第一个和最后一个可用标签，禁用项跳过。垂直列表用上、下方向键。焦点轮廓向内绘制，减少动态效果时停用标签与指示线的过渡。

<script lang="ts">
	import { Tabs as TabsPrimitive } from "bits-ui";
	import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		class: className,
		...restProps
	}: TabsPrimitive.ContentProps = $props();
</script>

<TabsPrimitive.Content
	bind:ref
	data-slot="tabs-content"
	class={cn("text-sm min-w-0 flex-1 outline-none", className)}
	{...restProps}
/>

<script lang="ts" module>
	import { tv, type VariantProps } from "tailwind-variants";

	export const tabsListVariants = tv({
		base: "rounded-lg p-[3px] group-data-horizontal/tabs:h-8 group-data-horizontal/tabs:py-0.5 data-[variant=line]:rounded-none group/tabs-list inline-flex w-fit max-w-full items-center justify-center-safe text-muted-foreground group-data-vertical/tabs:h-fit group-data-vertical/tabs:flex-col data-horizontal:scrollbar-none data-horizontal:overflow-x-auto",
		variants: {
			variant: {
				default: "bg-muted",
				line: "gap-1 bg-transparent",
				capsule: "gap-0.5 rounded-[5px] bg-[lch(100%_0_282)] p-0 dark:bg-[lch(9.232%_0.85_272)] [--tabs-capsule-bg:white] [--tabs-capsule-ink:lch(40%_1_282)] [--tabs-capsule-hover:lch(96.914%_0_282)] [--tabs-capsule-hover-ink:lch(20%_1_282)] [--tabs-capsule-active:lch(95.543%_0_282)] [--tabs-capsule-active-ink:lch(10%_0_282)] [--tabs-capsule-focus:lch(53%_52.26_286.91)] [--tabs-capsule-shadow:0_0_0_0.5px_rgb(0_0_0/.088),0_3px_6px_-2px_rgb(0_0_0/.02),0_1px_1px_rgb(0_0_0/.04)] [--tabs-capsule-shadow-active:0_0_0_0.5px_rgb(0_0_0/.147)] dark:[--tabs-capsule-bg:lch(13.861%_1.043_272)] dark:[--tabs-capsule-ink:lch(63.304%_1.425_272)] dark:[--tabs-capsule-hover:lch(17.718%_1.043_272)] dark:[--tabs-capsule-hover-ink:lch(90.826%_1.425_272)] dark:[--tabs-capsule-active:lch(20.418%_1.429_272)] dark:[--tabs-capsule-active-ink:white] dark:[--tabs-capsule-focus:lch(47.918%_59.303_288.421)] dark:[--tabs-capsule-shadow:0_0_0_0.5px_rgb(255_255_255/.143),0_0.5px_1px_1px_rgb(0_0_0/.30)] dark:[--tabs-capsule-shadow-active:0_0_0_0.5px_rgb(255_255_255/.238)] group-data-horizontal/tabs:w-full",
			},
		},
		defaultVariants: {
			variant: "default",
		},
	});

	export type TabsListVariant = VariantProps<typeof tabsListVariants>["variant"];
</script>

<script lang="ts">
	import { Tabs as TabsPrimitive } from "bits-ui";
	import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		variant = "default",
		class: className,
		onfocusin,
		...restProps
	}: TabsPrimitive.ListProps & {
		variant?: TabsListVariant;
	} = $props();

	const revealFocusedTab: NonNullable<TabsPrimitive.ListProps["onfocusin"]> = (event) => {
		onfocusin?.(event);
		const list = event.currentTarget;
		const tab = event.target;
		if (
			event.defaultPrevented ||
			list.dataset.orientation !== "horizontal" ||
			list.scrollWidth <= list.clientWidth ||
			!(tab instanceof HTMLElement) ||
			!tab.hasAttribute("data-tabs-trigger") ||
			tab.closest("[data-tabs-list]") !== list
		)
			return;

		const start = list.getBoundingClientRect().left + list.clientLeft;
		const end = start + list.clientWidth;
		const bounds = tab.getBoundingClientRect();
		if (bounds.left < start) list.scrollBy({ left: bounds.left - start, behavior: "instant" });
		else if (bounds.right > end) list.scrollBy({ left: bounds.right - end, behavior: "instant" });
	};
</script>

<TabsPrimitive.List
	bind:ref
	data-slot="tabs-list"
	data-variant={variant}
	class={cn(tabsListVariants({ variant }), className)}
	onfocusin={revealFocusedTab}
	{...restProps}
/>

		"group-data-[variant=line]/tabs-list:bg-transparent group-data-[variant=line]/tabs-list:data-active:bg-transparent dark:group-data-[variant=line]/tabs-list:data-active:border-transparent dark:group-data-[variant=line]/tabs-list:data-active:bg-transparent",
		"data-active:bg-background data-active:text-foreground dark:group-not-data-[variant=capsule]/tabs-list:data-active:border-input dark:group-not-data-[variant=capsule]/tabs-list:data-active:bg-input/30 dark:group-not-data-[variant=capsule]/tabs-list:data-active:text-foreground",
		"after:pointer-events-none after:absolute after:bg-foreground after:opacity-0 after:transition-opacity group-data-horizontal/tabs:after:inset-x-0 group-data-horizontal/tabs:after:bottom-0 group-data-horizontal/tabs:after:h-0.5 group-data-vertical/tabs:after:inset-y-0 group-data-vertical/tabs:after:end-0 group-data-vertical/tabs:after:w-0.5 motion-reduce:after:transition-none group-data-[variant=line]/tabs-list:data-active:after:opacity-100",
		"group-data-vertical/tabs:group-data-[variant=capsule]/tabs-list:h-7 group-data-[variant=capsule]/tabs-list:rounded-full group-data-[variant=capsule]/tabs-list:border-[0.5px] group-data-[variant=capsule]/tabs-list:border-transparent group-data-[variant=capsule]/tabs-list:px-3 group-data-[variant=capsule]/tabs-list:py-1 group-data-[variant=capsule]/tabs-list:text-xs group-data-[variant=capsule]/tabs-list:bg-(--tabs-capsule-bg) group-data-[variant=capsule]/tabs-list:text-(color:--tabs-capsule-ink) group-data-[variant=capsule]/tabs-list:shadow-(--tabs-capsule-shadow) group-data-[variant=capsule]/tabs-list:hover:not-data-active:bg-(--tabs-capsule-hover) group-data-[variant=capsule]/tabs-list:hover:not-data-active:text-(color:--tabs-capsule-hover-ink) group-data-[variant=capsule]/tabs-list:hover:shadow-(--tabs-capsule-shadow-active) group-data-[variant=capsule]/tabs-list:data-active:border-transparent group-data-[variant=capsule]/tabs-list:data-active:bg-(--tabs-capsule-active) group-data-[variant=capsule]/tabs-list:data-active:text-(color:--tabs-capsule-active-ink) group-data-[variant=capsule]/tabs-list:data-active:shadow-(--tabs-capsule-shadow-active) group-data-[variant=capsule]/tabs-list:focus-visible:border-transparent group-data-[variant=capsule]/tabs-list:focus-visible:ring-0 group-data-[variant=capsule]/tabs-list:focus-visible:outline-(color:--tabs-capsule-focus) group-data-[variant=capsule]/tabs-list:duration-150 group-data-[variant=capsule]/tabs-list:hover:duration-0",
		className
	)}
	{...restProps}

<script lang="ts">
